primary_external_source_policy: primary research, official/authoritative technical sources and direct implementation precedent; secondary/community material not used for promotion
main_results: Execution-generation fencing is strongly strengthened: effect authorization, caller-bound generation capability and provider idempotency/outcome reconciliation are orthogonal gates.

Open-web structural non-authority is strengthened but transformed: hard capability/IFC enforcement should be complemented by non-authoritative semantic provenance/audit for transformed or persistent influence.
Long-horizon memory should be tested as a dual plane: authoritative execution-state/event lineage plus semantic associative memory.
Adaptive recurrence is strengthened; the general rule more loops is better is rejected. Fixed-depth, adaptive-stop and stability/livelock controls are required.
Explicit GWT remains plausible but must beat information-equivalent shared-memory/cross-attention baselines under causal lesion/re-entry tests.
Hyperposition should be pairwise-first and promote higher-order edges only on measured irreducible interaction value.
UnifiedDB should test selective event sourcing for authority-critical transitions rather than universal event sourcing, against a simple versioned SQLite baseline.

ClayCode should put maximal static/effect rigor on identity/provenance/execution-generation/authority boundaries while compiling low-risk internal representations aggressively without creating a second semantic authority.
Proactive agency remains plausible/owner-required but needs an independent liveness/progress predicate, verified outcomes and valid idle behavior.

HF2-07 selective event+sandbox snapshot+projection vs simple versioned SQLite crash/replay benchmark.
